subtitles.en: No matter you know doesn't matter that much right now so that's one thing we're looking much more for now in terms of expectations in terms of growth and what 2027 will look like but I think going back to your point about you know China being overlooked and being under price.
subtitles.zh: 目前这并不那么重要。我们更关注增长预期和2027年的前景。回到你提到的观点，中国资产被忽视且定价偏低。

subtitles.en: I think it's actually a matter of a function of the lack of capital markets a lot of capital market activity which is why I think I'm quite excited to see a you know the obviously the overnight news about clean raising money and having a valuation of that close to 15 to 18 billion US dollars.
subtitles.zh: 这实际上是资本市场活动不足的体现。因此，我很兴奋地看到昨晚的消息——某公司融资，估值接近150-180亿美元。
en_highlights: valuation of that close to 15 to 18 billion

subtitles.en: We're also going to see potentially chip major chip companies in China listing as well and I think these are actually very strong catalyst for the market to actually go hey we haven't seen much realization of value.
subtitles.zh: 我们可能还会看到中国主要芯片公司上市。我认为这些是强有力的催化剂，让市场意识到价值尚未充分实现。

subtitles.en: We don't know where the benchmark or where the actual market was and now we're actually seeing more and more of these valuation being a benchmark and providing global investors to know hey there might be a potential under pricing in China.
subtitles.zh: 我们之前不知道基准在哪里，现在越来越多的估值成为基准，让全球投资者意识到中国可能存在定价偏低。

subtitles.en: And going back to your point this is exactly why global X in Australia launched the global X tech China tech ETF or ticker code DRGN or Dragon.
subtitles.zh: 回到你的观点，这正是Global X在澳大利亚推出中国科技ETF（代码DRGN）的原因。

subtitles.en: It's because we do believe that there is very strong value and very strong growth in this market going for not just in the next five years but potentially decades.
subtitles.zh: 因为我们相信这个市场有强劲的价值和增长，不仅未来五年，甚至可能持续数十年。

subtitles.en: What what could spark that tipping point then for people to tilt more back into this this this this realm right of China tech is it going to be earnings I mean what what do you think is going to be that catalyst.
subtitles.zh: 那么，什么能触发转折点，让人们重新关注中国科技领域？是盈利吗？你认为催化剂是什么？

subtitles.zh: 是的，好问题。我认为我提到的资本市场活动——越来越多的IPO和融资——会让市场了解这些中国资产的真实价值。

subtitles.en: You're correct to say that that's a good observation I mean even we just look at the U.S. stocks index or the philly philly philly semi index in terms of turnover it's nearly doubled in the past 12 months and I think that is a function of like you said we've seen more leverage products whether it be 2x 3x single stock and I think that has driven a lot of the strength.
subtitles.zh: 你的观察很对。即使看美国指数或费城半导体指数，过去12个月成交量几乎翻倍。我认为这是杠杆产品（如2倍、3倍单股ETF）推动的。

subtitles.en: But I think it's also important to know that yes there is a lot of liquidity driven strength in terms of where the index levels are but at the same time we are looking at a potential market which is growing at over 100% and potentially 30% or even 40% next year but still trading a single digits.
subtitles.zh: 但重要的是，指数水平确实有流动性驱动的强势，同时我们看到的潜在市场增长超过100%，明年可能30%-40%，但估值仍在个位数。

subtitles.en: So I think in terms of you know like you mentioned it is very much market dynamics or market technicals right now but in terms of the long term structural growth valuation we don't see this as a very big issue right now.
subtitles.zh: 所以，目前更多是市场动态或技术面因素，但从长期结构性增长和估值看，我们并不认为这是大问题。

clips.speaker: Billy Lung
clips.title: GlobalX策略师：AI交易扩散，关注基建能源商品？

subtitles.en: Well I think you know I think AI trades really really got breath now everyone I think yes you know AI trade have been driven by semiconductors I think a lot of things that people haven't been looking at is actually the peaks and shovels that go behind AI and it's not just your memories it's not just your GPUs or whatever it's also the infrastructure that goes behind it.
subtitles.zh: 我认为AI交易已经扩散。虽然半导体驱动，但人们忽视的是AI背后的“卖铲人”——不仅是存储和GPU，还有基础设施。

subtitles.en: You know what are the companies that are actually building the data centers you know this actually requires a lot of interconnect cables power equipment power cooling equipment optical cables which again is a very strong market in China right now and these are one of the key things that we've been looking at as well at the picks and shovels of who are the winners that's going to come out from this increased hyper scale of spending.
subtitles.zh: 建设数据中心的公司需要大量互联电缆、电源设备、冷却设备、光缆等，这些在中国市场非常强劲。我们关注这些“卖铲人”中的赢家。

subtitles.en: And I guess the third sort of layer things to look at is what are the energy and also commodities that go behind it when all the copper wire that goes into data center again something that we've been looking at very very strongly and even when you look at the energy is overall energy going to be powered by renewable resources such as uranium these are very much the derivatives that we need to look at when we consider the AI trade.
subtitles.zh: 第三层是能源和商品，比如数据中心用的铜线。我们也在关注能源是否由可再生能源（如铀）提供。这些都是AI交易的衍生机会。
